node.title: Re: Append a line with special characters before a string
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
That doesn't sound like a text file to me, but like an HTML file. HTML is not a line-oriented format. What if the tag has attributes on the next line? What if the line that contains has tags immediately following it on the same line, or even the entire HTML file on one line, which is also possible? What I am trying to say is, use a [id://1191195|proper parser]. Also, why are you not inserting the into ? Anyway, here's an example using [mod://Mojo::DOM]:

use warnings; use strict; use Mojo::DOM; my $html = q{}; my $insert = q{}; my $dom = Mojo::DOM->new($html); $dom->find('head')->each(sub { $_->child_nodes->first->prepend($insert) }); print "$dom\n"; __END__
